description: Move one wishlist item to the inventory as bought, and record the purchase date, the price paid and the store in the same step. It stays the same item with the same id; no second item is created. The first call describes the change and returns a confirm token. Nothing is changed without that token. A second call with that token applies it. purchase_date is YYYY-MM-DD and is today (UTC) when left out. purchase_price and purchased_from are optional. The price paid is not saved as the item's value: current_value is not written, and the wishlist target price stays on the item. On a US dollar account the item can get one market value lookup in the background, the same as on the website. Only a wishlist item can be marked bought. A gift, or an item that is already in the inventory, lent, borrowed or archived, is refused and nothing is changed. Mark a gift bought with update_item and gift_status instead.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

item_id.description: The wishlist item that was bought

purchase_date.description: The day it was bought, YYYY-MM-DD. Left out, it is today (UTC).

purchase_price.description: What was paid. Optional. It is not saved as the item's value.

purchased_from.description: The store it was bought from. Optional.

name: mark_wishlist_item_bought
title: Mark wishlist item bought
